description: Publish-stage script that builds a standalone QA web page for a set of NIfTI volumes using NiiVue's saveHTML/generateHTML extension, writing a self-contained index.html to the session output directory.

volumes.description: Volumes to render into the QA page (typically the filtered volumes).

title.description: Heading shown on the QA page.

block.label: NiiVue QA Page
block.description: Render a shareable QA page with NiiVue saveHTML.

neuroflow/launch.description: Reads $NEUROFLOW_SESSION/context.json, builds an NVDocument from inputs.volumes, and writes $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR/index.html via the NiiVue save-html extension.
